notes: 3/9 runs 5/5 with simulator truth (15/45 trials); 6 runs stopped at the driver gate before any actuation (5 by the 40-call front limit, x-s8675-r1 by three consecutive truncated responses). Zero unconfirmed actuations, no transient or rate-limit retries.

Driver gate: every run failed '驅動程式拒絕失敗或毀損回覆' first; 94 of 99 driver versions accepted the write reply carrying lift value 7, while structural faults (CRC, unit address, exception codes, empty, non-hex) were rejected. The VLAB-X contract states that corrupted replies must throw.
Truncations: 12, all during onboarding with 6,400-7,900 thinking tokens against the 8,192 output limit (unchanged by protocol).

Completed runs 0.99-1.18x the offline reference; their controllers replayed on all three seeds 9/9 complete, own-seed action counts equal the live runs. The 3 gate-rejected controller versions would each complete all three seeds (analysis only).
